component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: Thanksgiving after Communion
component.source: Psalm 103:1-5, Psalter of the Book of Common Prayer (1979), verbatim. Response: 2 Corinthians 9:15 (World English Bible). Every spoken word is scripture.

original.p: Psalm 103:1-5 (BCP 1979): Bless the LORD, O my soul, * and all that is within me, bless his holy Name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, * and forget not all his benefits. He forgives all your sins * and heals all your infirmities; He redeems your life from the grave * and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness; He satisfies you with good things, * and your youth is renewed like an eagle’s.
2 Corinthians 9:15 (WEB): Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

p.line: Bless the Lord, O my soul,
and all that is within me, bless his holy Name.
Bless the Lord, O my soul,
and forget not all his benefits.
He redeems your life from the grave
and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness;
He satisfies you with good things,
and your youth is renewed like an eagle’s.

block.response: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
